attempts.summary: On node1, configured pam_pwquality (already wired into system-auth/password-auth via authselect) to require minlen=12 and minclass=3. Verified enforcement end-to-end through the real PAM self-service passwd path (not chpasswd/root bypass, which skip pwquality). Performed the mandatory single-node reboot with boot_id proof of restart, and re-verified policy persistence and enforcement after reboot.
